name: Sitelemetry
description:
Sitelemetry gives Claude a structured, non-mutating assessment of a website covered by the authenticated customer's exact workspace verification. It checks security posture, technical SEO, AI-search visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, WCAG-oriented accessibility, Core Web Vitals, or all six pillars together. Results contain prioritized findings, evidence, impact, passing checks and remediation guidance, plus one authenticated report URL that remains stable during its report-retention window of up to 30 days.

The Claude profile is verified-only and rejects an unverified target before an audit module runs. It blocks private-network destinations, revalidates every redirect hop, binds OAuth tokens to the exact Claude MCP resource, and enforces rate, quota and concurrency controls. The connector does not modify the target, initiate payments, expose plan/pricing links, or request Claude conversation history, memory or unrelated files.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sitelemetry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sitelemetry to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude-mcp.sitelemetry.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sitelemetry MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sitelemetry provides these MCP tools: audit_accessibility, audit_ai_visibility, audit_full, audit_integrations, audit_performance, audit_security, and audit_seo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sitelemetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sitelemetry in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Sitelemetry requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sitelemetry is developed by Egenil Teleferik. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
